messages:
olivia_csm: FYI — Meridian Health renewal in 4 weeks. Usage has gone quiet the last 3 weeks after onboarding stalled on an SSO blocker. Procurement told me they’re trialing CompetitorX. Need rapid triage.

maria_cs: Can you drop some numbers? 30d / 7d / 3d activity so we can show trends?

olivia_csm: 30d avg ~12k tokens/day, 7d avg ~4.6k, last 3d ~900. Onboarding cohort of 5 teams completed only 1 of 3 training sessions. SSO ticket #INC-1327 stuck with vendor.

ben_se: I pushed a patch yesterday; vendor rejected the cert chain rotation. They're reissuing certs. Ticket INC-1327: https://support.example.com/INC-1327

jeff_support: Logs show 401 spikes from meridian-sso between Mar 10–13. Scrubbed gist of traces: https://gist.github.com/scrubbed-logs

sam_pm: Who's the internal champion now? Any stakeholder changes?

olivia_csm: Lina (champion) moved to product last week. New IT Dir is Raj Patel — hasn't joined enablement calls. Procurement lead Hannah mentioned a feature parity checklist from CompetitorX.

anna_success_ops: Proposed playbook:
1) Exec intro: Raj + our SVP product
2) Dedicated SSO debug block w/eng (1–2 hrs)
3) Fast-track integration docs + training for the 5 teams
4) 1-week usage escalation plan (incentive credits + onboarding office hours)
Thoughts?

maria_cs: +1 to exec intro. Also need a concise migration-risk matrix vs CompetitorX (top 5 gaps) for the exec call.

ben_se: I'll draft the feature-gap matrix and run the SSO session tomorrow 10–12 PT.

olivia_csm: Scheduling exec intro for Wed 9am PT. Inviting Raj, Hannah, our SVP, cc @sam_pm. Including the SSO block in the invite. Owners: ben_se (tech), maria_cs (renewal play), anna_success_ops (enablement docs).

jeff_support: Monitoring alert added for login failures; bumping priority to P1 for Meridian.

sam_pm: If we move fast, we can keep renewal on track. Maria — can you draft the renewal options (including credits) after the sync?

maria_cs: Yep — draft due Thu COB.

olivia_csm: Thanks team. I'll post outcomes after Wed sync. :thumbsup:

system_bot: Meeting scheduled: Wed Mar 18 09:00 PT — Meridian Health exec sync (calendar invite sent).
